name: ai-agent-lanes

frames.best_why: Every lane is complete, a step tooltip is open and the final answer is typed out.

tagline: A playhead sweeps a gantt chart as one agent fans work out to three helpers.
summary: A dark card that replays an AI run: a lead lane forks into parallel sub-agent lanes of tool-call bars on a timed track, with hover tooltips, a scrubber and a transcript that types out the final answer.
appearance: A rounded dark card holds a tiny status line and a white task question above four named lanes. Coloured horizontal bars (teal for search and read, grey for thinking, white for writing) sit on a dashed track with a vertical playhead, second ruler and a small tool legend; the transcript fills the bottom.
behaviour: On first view a playhead moves left to right, bars grow under it, curved lines connect the lead to each sub-agent and finished lanes swap their dot for a teal tick. Hovering a bar opens a tooltip, the play button pauses or replays, and the answer types out as the last lead step runs.
demo_content: Task about a 30-person May offsite; lanes Flights, Venues and Weather; answer recommends Lisbon.
search_phrases: gantt chart of ai agents working
watch sub agents run in parallel
timeline of tool calls per agent
lead agent handing tasks to workers
parallel task lanes with a playhead
use_when: You want to show how a lead agent split work across sub-agents, step by step, with real timings.
avoid_when: Small screens or dense pages: four lanes, a ruler and a transcript need width to stay legible.
customise: Task, lanes, answer and an optional elapsed clock are props; the tool colours, bar shapes and pixel masks live in the source.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame loop redraws the bars while the run plays; it idles when paused or done.

a11y.note: Play, scrub and lane controls are labelled and keyboard reachable; reduced motion jumps straight to the finished run.

props.name: task
props.default: "Where should our 30-person team meet for a May offsite?"

issues: Status, ruler ticks and legend text are tiny and faint on the dark card.
polish_why: Dense but clear agent trace view with useful controls; the smallest labels are hard to read.
title: AI Agent Lanes
